operationPin.title: Products and inventory PIN
operationPin.description: Protect product changes and inventory movements with a company-wide 6-digit PIN. Every change requires confirmation, including changes made by the owner.
operationPin.enabled: Protection enabled for everyone, including the owner.
operationPin.notConfigured: Operation PIN has not been configured.
operationPin.ownerOnly: Only the owner can create or change this PIN after verifying their own email.
operationPin.saved: Operation PIN saved. Products and inventory are protected.
operationPin.emailHint: We will send a 6-digit code to your owner account email. Email verification is required to create or change the operation PIN.
operationPin.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code sent to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes and can only be used once.
operationPin.newPasswordHint: Identity verified. Create a PIN with exactly 6 digits. Keep it safe: it will be required when changing products or inventory.
operationPin.failed: Could not complete the request. Try again.
operationPin.invalidCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your email.
operationPin.invalidPassword: The PIN must contain exactly 6 digits.
operationPin.promptHint: Enter the 6-digit operation PIN configured in Settings → Security. The owner must also provide this PIN.
